$description: Every name Kuiper shipped and no longer ships, with what replaces it. A custom property's --color- form, and its utilities, go with it.

removed.name: --code-foreground
removed.note: Code's body text is its own ink, no longer the page's foreground.

removed.name: --color-code-foreground
removed.note: The Tailwind colour of --code-foreground, and its utilities, gone with it.
